stories.title: The joy and pain that define baseball were in full force in Rays' incredible Game 4 win
stories.summary: Milwaukee didn't get its sweep Tuesday night. Instead, the rest of the baseball world got a treat -- and another day to savor the sport.

stories.title: Williamson keeps Rays alive in WS; Caminero '100%' set for Game 5 despite injury
stories.summary: The Rays avoided a sweep with a stunning 12th-inning rally versus the Brewers to take Game 4 of the World Series.

stories.title: Morant to appeal as he, Blazers miffed by flopping techs vs. Lakers
stories.summary: Trail Blazers star Ja Morant says he plans to appeal a technical foul he received for flopping, one of three handed out late in Portland's 136-129 win over the Lakers.

stories.title: Dream say concerns over finding available Finals venue went unheeded
stories.summary: In a letter to the city, the Atlanta Dream said Game 6 getting moved to 12:30 p.m. so they can play in State Farm Arena was "not what we fought for."

stories.title: Riley says USC 'right place for me' and 'I'm the right person to be here'
stories.summary: Amid questions surrounding his future with the program, USC coach Lincoln Riley said Tuesday, "This is where I want to be. This is the right place for me. I'm the right person to be here."
